quarterly_data.quarter: LG Innotek IR presentation: Q1 2026 results (04-27-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Q1 2026 results deck: the company reported record-high Q1 revenue of KRW 5,534.8 billion (+11.1% YoY, -27.3% QoQ) and operating income of KRW 295.3 billion (5.3% operating margin vs 2.5% in Q1 2025). By division: Optics Solution KRW 4,610.6 billion (+11.4% YoY, -30.6% QoQ), Package Solution KRW 437.1 billion (+16.0% YoY, -10.7% QoQ), Mobility Solution KRW 487.1 billion (+4.2% YoY, +2.7% QoQ). Net income KRW 229.1 billion; liabilities-to-equity ratio improved to 94%.

quarterly_data.quarter: LG Innotek IR presentation: Q1 2026 results (04-27-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Q1 2026 deck, Package Solution (substrates: RF-SiP, AiP, FC-CSP, FC-BGA; display: COF, photomask): strong sales momentum continued for high-value substrates such as RF-SiP and FC-CSP, while FC-BGA is undergoing a transition toward high-end products for AI and server applications. Q2 2026 outlook: strong demand for high-value substrates is expected to continue, supporting sustained year-on-year growth; customer expansion and development efforts are underway with a focus on high-end FC-BGA products. Key strategies: develop core technologies and expand the customer base for FC-BGA, expand premium FC-CSP AP positioning and high-performance memory products, and advance high-density Cu-Post technology for substrates.

quarterly_data.quarter: LG Innotek IR presentation: Q1 2026 results (04-27-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Q1 2026 deck, other divisions' outlook: Optics Solution - despite seasonal softness, smartphone camera demand remained resilient and auto camera sales to key customers expanded; for Q2 2026, despite a temporary slowdown ahead of a new model cycle, year-on-year growth is expected to be sustained, and the company plans to expand automotive camera supply while advancing robotic vision solutions and preparing for production. Mobility Solution - expanded new orders centred on autonomous mobility solutions; Q2 2026 sales are expected to increase, driven by high-value products with a focus on lighting and communication modules, while accelerating new growth drivers including AP modules.
